title: Isolation of Single Nuclei from Human Brain and Immunostaining for NeuN
author: Marcos Otero-Garcia
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6tuhenw

steps.title: Prepare Immunostaining and Incubation Buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the necessary buffers for the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Prepare buffer for Immunostaining by mixing: 2925 µL IM1, 3 µL DTT 1mM, 30 µL 50x Protease Inhibitor, 15 µL RNaseIN 40U/µl, 30 µL TritonX100 10% v/v, 9400 µL RNase-free PBS (pH7.4), 500 µL RNase-free 10% BSA, 50 µL 1 M MgCl2, and 10 µL DNAse I (2000 U/ml).
Prepare buffer for Antibody incubation (1.5 ml per sample) by adding 5 µL of RNaseIN 40 U/µl to 1 mL of buffer for Immunostaining (final concentration 0.2U/µl).
Prepare Homogenization Buffer and cool on ice.

steps.title: Prepare Tissue and Homogenizer
steps.instruction: Prepare the brain tissue and the dounce tissue grinder for homogenization.

substeps.instruction: Pre-cool the dounce tissue grinder (Kimble Kontes all glass, 7 mL tubes, 0.02 - 0.056 mm clearance) on ice.
Collect a brain chunk (~100 mg) and transfer to a Petri dish on ice.
Cut the tissue into small pieces using a chilled scalpel or blade.

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt the tissue to release nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Add 2.4 mL of Homogenization buffer to the dounce tissue grinder.
Transfer all tissue pieces into the grinder.
Homogenize on ice using ~30 firm strokes; verify with a hematocytometer to ensure no cell clumps remain and nuclei are not damaged.

steps.title: Filter and Concentrate Nuclei
steps.instruction: Remove debris and concentrate the nuclei pellet.

substeps.instruction: Filter the homogenate through a 40 µm Corning cell strainer to remove clumps.
Take a sample for hemocytometer analysis.
Transfer homogenate into two precooled 1.5 ml Eppendorf tubes.
Centrifuge for 00:08:00 at 4 °C.
Slowly aspirate the supernatant from the side of the tube, leaving up to 50 µL.

steps.title: Perform Iodixanol Gradient Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Purify nuclei using a density gradient.

substeps.instruction: Gently resuspend each pellet in 225 µL of cold Homogenization buffer and pool both tubes (final volume 450 µL).
Add 450 µL of cold 50% v/v iodixanol to the suspension (final iodixanol concentration 25%).
Add 900 µL of 29% iodixanol into a 2 ml Eppendorf tube.
Slowly layer the 25% iodixanol suspension over the 29% iodixanol without mixing.
Centrifuge for 00:20:00 at 4 °C.

steps.title: Recover and Block Nuclei
steps.instruction: Isolate the nuclei pellet and prepare for staining.

substeps.instruction: Remove and discard the top myelin-rich debris layer (using a 1 ml pipette with cut tip or cotton swabs).
Remove and discard the aqueous supernatant without disrupting the nuclei pellet.
Resuspend the pellet using a small amount of buffer for Antibody Incubation and transfer to a new tube.
Gently resuspend in 500 µL of buffer for Antibody Incubation.
Incubate for 00:15:00 at 4 °C (or on ice) to block nonspecific staining.
Take samples for hemocytometer, unstained control, and 2AB-only control.
Add primary antibody (Ms-a-NeuN, 1:1000; clone A60 Merck Millipore Catalog #MAB377) and incubate on a rotator in the cold room (4 °C) for 00:40:00.
Note: Use BSA-coated Eppendorfs (coat by filling with 10% BSA in PBS for 00:05:00, rinse with PBS, and dry at 4 °C overnight).

steps.title: Wash and Recover Nuclei
steps.instruction: Wash away unbound primary antibody and recover all nuclei.

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL of buffer for Immunostaining and invert several times.
Centrifuge for 00:05:00 at 4 °C.
Transfer all supernatant to a new Eppendorf tube.
Resuspend the remaining pellet in 400 µL of buffer for Antibody Incubation.
Centrifuge the transferred supernatant for 00:05:00 at 4 °C to recover non-pelleted nuclei.
Resuspend these nuclei in 200 µL of buffer for Antibody Incubation and pool with the previous fraction for a final volume of 600 µL.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody and DNA Staining
steps.instruction: Apply secondary antibody and nuclear stain.

substeps.instruction: Take samples for single color staining.
Add secondary antibody (G-a-Ms Alexa Fluor 647, 1:1000) and Hoechst 33258 (5 µg/ml; 1:1000 of 2.5 mg/ml stock) to the tube.
Verify quality and count via hemocytometer (expected ~2 Million nuclei in ~0.6 ml for 100 mg tissue).

steps.title: FACS Sorting and Collection
steps.instruction: Sort nuclei and stabilize them for downstream assays.

substeps.instruction: Transfer nuclei to 7 ml culture tubes and keep on ice.
Bring to FACS facility for sorting using controls: Non-stained, 2AB only, and Single stainings.
Collect nuclei into BSA-coated Eppendorfs containing collection medium (~1/5 of expected final volume).
Add BSA after collection to reach a final 1% BSA concentration.
